title: Operations Center
subtitle: Live map, team, alerts and today's numbers in one place.

MAP_TILES_UNAVAILABLE.title: Map unavailable right now
MAP_TILES_UNAVAILABLE.body: The list and alerts still work. Your data is safe.

OPS_NO_LIVE_OPERATORS.title: No one is live right now
OPS_NO_LIVE_OPERATORS.body: Jobs and alerts are still visible. When someone goes on duty, the map updates.

ALERTS_COLLAPSED.title: Similar alerts were grouped
ALERTS_COLLAPSED.body: No alert was hidden. Open the group to handle them one by one.

OPERATOR_STALE.title: Location is out of date
OPERATOR_STALE.body: We are showing the last known position. The operator's work is safe.

REALTIME_DISCONNECTED.title: Live updates paused
REALTIME_DISCONNECTED.body: We are showing the last received data. Reconnection is automatic.

activity.title: Live feed
activity.action: {action} · {entity, select, WORK_ORDER {work order} FIELD_REPORT {field report} RENTAL {rental} ASSET {machine} USER {user} DEVICE {phone} other {record}}

operators.title: Team on the map ({count})
operators.trailPoints: {count, plural, one {# position recorded.} other {# positions recorded.}}
operators.trailGaps: Breaks in the line mean the phone sent no position for a while.

items.operators: Team member (ring colour shows status, initials inside)
items.operatorsStale: Team member with an out-of-date position (greyed)
items.workOrdersRisk: Job with SLA at risk (yellow) or breached (red)
items.rentals: Rental with the customer (triangle, red when overdue)

exports.title: Export to CSV
exports.hint: Files use ; as separator and open in Excel with accents intact.

started.title: We are preparing the file
started.body: You can keep working. We will notify you when the CSV is ready.

exports.ready: Your CSV is ready to download.
exports.failed: We could not prepare this file. Nothing was changed. Try the export again.
exports.expired: This link expired after 7 days. Export again to get a new file.
